verdict.rationale: Docs show run_job() async endpoint returning a job ID, /job/{job_id} status polling in the OpenAPI spec, and configurable Svix webhooks (with cryptographic signing, retries, and a delivery dashboard) that can be wired up in Reducto Studio, directly matching the async-with-webhooks pipeline story. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on report confirming webhook reliability at scale or long-parse completion behavior in production.
